Class.name: IHC.ITF.Process.Bpl.CernOrdersHl7ToIvxCloudPharmacy
Class.Description: iCentra Pharmacy Med Orders to IVXCloud (OmniCell IV Compounding services)

Property.name: LocationOperationsTable
Property.Description: Ensemble Lookup Table to route data out the correct Ensemble operation which sends to the associated IVXCloud based on MSH-4 Facility

Property.name: FilterInMedsTable
Property.Description: Ensemble Lookup Table to filter in the Med Orders based on the RXO-1 needed specificially for the IVXCloud services

Property.name: HddTargetConfigName
Property.Description: HDD Operation: The target name used for HDD calls

Property.name: NotAllowedLocations
Property.Description: NCIDs for MSH-4 that will be used to filter out the record and not processed it. For example: 525935320 - CERNER - 199 Enterprise Facility used for updates. "999999,99999999" are not real NCIDS values and are used here as place holders that should be replaced when adding real NCID values
